resolution: Removed inherited engine and all its workspace dependencies instead of obtaining new grants.
evidence: Cargo.lock contains no theseus, ariadne, modrinth-content-management, path-util, serde-binhum, daedalus or async-minecraft-ping.
cargo metadata --locked --filter-platform x86_64-pc-windows-msvc confirms independent workspace plus declared registry dependencies.
scripts/third-party.mjs rejects retired packages and preserves locked dependency licence texts.
third-party/licence-supplements/sources.json records exact upstream licence sources and checksums.
instructions: This review resolves the removed engine issue only. Preserve current dependency notices and exact corresponding source in every build. Windows/runtime/signature acceptance is separate.
